meta_title: Clarendon Park Plumbing | Local Plumber Leicester
meta_description: Clarendon Park Plumbing offers expert plumbing services across Leicester. Fast response, competitive rates, and quality workmanship guaranteed. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Qualified Plumber — Fast Response Across Leicester
hero_subhead: Leaking pipes, boiler issues, or a full bathroom fit-out — we respond fast and get it fixed right first time.
services_subhead: From urgent emergency repairs to full bathroom installations, we cover every plumbing need for homeowners and landlords throughout Leicester.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or sudden loss of water pressure — we aim to reach you within the hour. No unnecessary call-out charges, just fast, effective repairs when you need them most.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with an annual service from our experienced engineers. We work across all major boiler brands and can diagnose faults quickly to restore your heating and hot water.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Whether you're replacing an ageing suite or planning a full redesign, we handle every aspect of your bathroom installation. From pipework to final finishes, we deliver a clean, high-quality result on time and on budget.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We use proven detection methods to pinpoint the source quickly and carry out lasting repairs with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Central Heating Installation & Repairs
services.desc: From new radiator installations to full central heating system upgrades, we ensure your home stays warm and your system runs at peak efficiency. We're happy to advise on the most cost-effective solution for your property.

services.title: Landlord & General Plumbing
services.desc: Ideal for landlords and letting agents needing reliable, responsive plumbing maintenance across rental properties. We handle everything from dripping taps and blocked drains to full pipe replacements, keeping your tenants happy and your property compliant.

about_pullquote: Every job, whether big or small, deserves the same care and commitment.
about_para_1: Clarendon Park Plumbing was established to bring genuinely reliable, high-quality plumbing to homeowners and landlords across Leicester. Based in the heart of Clarendon Park, we've built our reputation street by street, delivering consistent workmanship and honest advice to our local community.
about_para_2: We believe the best advertisement is a happy customer, which is why we never cut corners and always leave your home as tidy as we found it. Our customers return to us time and again — and recommend us to their neighbours — because they know they're getting a local plumber they can actually trust.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called Clarendon Park Plumbing after noticing a leak under our kitchen sink on a Saturday morning. They were with us within the hour, sorted the problem quickly, and the price was very fair. Absolutely brilliant service — won't use anyone else.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: Had a new bathroom suite fitted and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. Turned up when they said they would, the work was tidy and well done, and they cleaned up completely before leaving. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Reliable, honest, and reasonably priced. I've used them twice now — once for a boiler issue and once to sort out some dodgy pipework in the loft. Both times the job was done properly with no fuss. Highly recommend to anyone in Leicester.
reviews.author: Mark T.
